release_title: TopUp Net Gateway v1.0.10 (Clickable Alerts, Chime Sound & Smooth Dashboard)
changelog:
- Clickable Review Alerts: Tapping Waiting Approval or Rejected notifications now opens directly inside the SMS Logs Waiting or Rejected tab.
- Custom Bundled Notification Chime: Embedded native payment_alert chime on a dedicated notification channel so alerts always stand out.
- Dashboard Flicker Fix & UI Polish: Migrated Dashboard to LazyColumn with clip bounds, disabled OEM force-dark leaks, and aligned brand accents.
- Cleaner Foreground Notification: Removed duplicate app name text, added custom monochrome receiver icon, and hardened idempotent keep-alive locks.
